subject: Pilot kickoff: Novus Insight — scope, success metrics & access guardrails
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@novusinsight.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: pilot scope & suggested next steps (Novus Insight)

Hi Alyssa — great to speak this morning. Quick recap of what we heard, the proposed pilot shape, and immediate asks so we can lock a kickoff next week. If I missed anything please flag.

1) Pain points you described
- Large batch inference spikes causing 95th percentile latency > 700ms for customer-facing features.
- Cost variability across peak hours; budgets need predictability for Q1.
- Prompt regressions when we scaled from dev to prod prompts (label drift / tokenization edge cases).

2) Pilot goals (mutually agreed)
- Latency: reduce 95th percentile to <250ms for the primary endpoint (95th measured over representative production traffic).
- Cost: demonstrate an average token cost reduction target of ~30% versus current baseline for standard prompt mix.
- Quality: maintain or improve NER F1 >= 0.92 on your labeled sample set; surface any regression cases.

3) Proposed pilot scope (4 weeks)
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): access + data handoff (S3 sample, service account), security questionnaire.
- Week 1: smoke tests, baseline measurements on-hosted API.
- Week 2–3: optimization pass (batching, KV caching, prompt sweep), nightly evals against prompt set.
- Week 4: final acceptance run and handoff doc + cost/latency report.

4) Success metrics & evals
- We'll run the attached pilot-metrics-template.xlsx and populate with baseline and weekly checkpoints.
- Prompt suite: please confirm the 120 prompts you referenced on the call (we'll need a labeled holdout for regression).

5) Owners (redwood / novus)
- Customer lead: Alyssa Chen (Novus Insight) — confirms sample dataset, acceptance signoff.
- Redwood eng owner: Karthik Iyer — runtime tuning, model variant recommendations.
- Redwood CS: Stephanie Nguyen — onboarding, access, and support.

6) Access & security notes (initial asks)
- Short-term: create an S3 bucket with read-only sample objects and share role ARN to connor@redwood.com.
- We'll need a primary security contact for the questionnaire (SOC2 / data handling).
- For sensitive PII cases we discussed, we can enable field-level redaction in the pipeline — we'll confirm exact steps once your security team signs off.

Attachments: pilot-metrics-template.xlsx, access-checklist.md

Next steps: please confirm the security contact and availability for a 30-min kickoff on Mon/Tue next week. Once we get that we'll send a calendar invite that includes the runbook and initial access checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Solutions 
Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0119

--

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@novusinsight.com>

Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: pilot scope & suggested next steps (Novus Insight)

Connor — thanks for the clear summary. All looks correct from our side. A couple of additions / clarifications: 

- Security contact: please loop Daniel Park (daniel.park@novusinsight.com) — he's on our privacy & compliance team and will own the questionnaire.
- Prompt suite: I can get the 120 prompt list and a 10% labeled holdout uploaded to the S3 bucket. Expect that by COB Mon.
- Timeline: we'd like the optimization pass to prioritize the FAQ endpoint first (it's highest volume) and then the NER endpoint. If you can reflect that in the kickoff agenda, great.
- SOC2 / legal: can you share the SOC2 cert link and a short note about data retention policy for the pilot? That will help Daniel.

We're available for kickoff Tue 12/22 or Wed 12/23 10–12 PT. Prefer Tue if you can do it.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Head of Product
Novus Insight
alyssa@novusinsight.com
